title: Facebook post comments
description: Scrape publicly served comments from Facebook post URLs without cookies. One row per comment or reply, with text, author, timestamp, reactions, stable URL, coverage status, and thread linkage.

postUrls.title: Post URLs
postUrls.description: Public Facebook URLs. Supported without login: page posts, group permalinks, story.php, and video pages. Reels, photo pages, and /watch/ are accepted for detection but Facebook does not serve their comment lists to signed-out visitors.

maxCommentsPerPost.title: Max comments per post
maxCommentsPerPost.description: Hard cap on rows (top-level + replies) per post. Public posts paginate 10 per request, so 300 costs about 30 requests.

maxPostsPerRun.title: Max posts per run
maxPostsPerRun.description: Maximum post URLs processed per run. Results multiply per post. Runs are processed in parallel, see maxConcurrency.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel posts
maxConcurrency.description: How many posts to walk at the same time. Each post keeps its own cursor and pacing, so 5 parallel posts finish roughly 5x faster than sequential ones.

queryMode.title: Query mode
queryMode.description: FRESH_LIST walks the live CommentsListComponentsPaginationQuery (10 per page, no ceiling on public content). LEGACY_TOPLEVEL is the old dusty pager that keeps returning the same 10 comments.

unionSorts.title: Union sort orders
unionSorts.description: Walk both the default order and NEWEST, then merge. Measured on a public post: the two windows had zero overlap, so this roughly doubles distinct comments per request.

commentsSortOrder.title: Comment sort order
commentsSortOrder.description: Facebook comment ordering. MOST_RELEVANT keeps the default window, NEWEST switches to reverse chronological, ALL_COMMENTS asks for the unfiltered chronological list.

knownCommentIds.title: Known comment IDs
knownCommentIds.description: Comment IDs you already have. They are skipped, so monitoring runs only return new comments.

knownDatasetId.title: Dataset with known comments
knownDatasetId.description: ID of a previous run dataset. Requires the actor to have permission to read that dataset; if the run logs an insufficient-permissions warning, use dedupeStoreName or knownCommentIds instead.

dedupeStoreName.title: Dedupe store name
dedupeStoreName.description: Name of a key-value store that remembers delivered comment IDs between runs. Set any stable name (e.g. my-group-monitor) and repeated runs will only return new comments.

failOnEmpty.title: Fail on empty result
failOnEmpty.description: Mark the run as failed when zero comments were collected. Useful for scheduled monitoring so an empty run is visible instead of silent.

includePostText.title: Include post text
includePostText.description: Copy the post caption into every comment row as post_text. Parsed from the permalink HTML the run already fetches, so it costs no extra requests.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: Expand reply threads of top-level comments. Replies paginate 10 per page to the end on public content.

maxReplyThreadsPerPost.title: Reply threads per post
maxReplyThreadsPerPost.description: How many reply-bearing parent comments to expand, fattest threads first. 0 = replies off.

maxRepliesPerPost.title: Max replies per post
maxRepliesPerPost.description: Hard cap on reply rows per post. Replies count toward maxCommentsPerPost as well.

pageDelayMs.title: Delay between pages (ms)
pageDelayMs.description: Pause between GraphQL pages. Default 1000 ms is the safest starting point; 200-400 ms has been tested for faster runs.

maxPagesPerPost.title: Max pages per post
maxPagesPerPost.description: Safety stop for the cursor walk. At 10 comments per page, 60 pages covers about 600 comments.

introDelayMs.title: Delay after page load (ms)
introDelayMs.description: Short settle after fetching the permalink HTML before the first GraphQL call. 0 disables it.

onlyCommentsNewerThan.title: Only comments newer than
onlyCommentsNewerThan.description: Keep only comments newer than this. Accepts an absolute date (2026-04-20) or a relative value like 30 days, 12 hours or 2 weeks. Empty = no filter.

proxyCountry.title: Proxy country
proxyCountry.description: Two-letter country code for the residential proxy. US is what the verified runs used.

proxyTier.title: Proxy tier
proxyTier.description: auto: start on the cheap datacenter pool and switch to residential automatically if Facebook blocks it. datacenter: cheapest. residential: the original behaviour, most conservative.

proxyGroups.title: Proxy groups
proxyGroups.description: Apify proxy groups. RESIDENTIAL is the verified default; DATACENTER is cheaper but more likely to be blocked.

minCommentsPerPost.title: Min comments per post
minCommentsPerPost.description: Density guard: stop early when the thread is known to be thinner than this. 0 = off.

startCursorByPost.title: Continuation cursors by post
startCursorByPost.description: Resume paging from a previous OUTPUT summary. Map post ID to {endCursor}. Never mix cursors across posts.
